description: This file provides functions and classes for generating textual descriptions of behave model elements, such as tables and docstrings, including escaping special characters and formatting output.

classes.name: ModelDescriptor
classes.description: Contains static methods for describing behave model elements like tables and docstrings.

classes.name: ModelPrinter
classes.description: Extends ModelDescriptor to print described tables and docstrings to a stream.

methods.name: escape_cell
methods.description: Escapes special characters in table cell content.

methods.name: escape_triple_quotes
methods.description: Escapes triple quotes in text for safe inclusion in docstrings.

methods.name: describe_table
methods.description: Generates a textual description of a behave table with optional indentation.

methods.name: describe_docstring
methods.description: Generates a textual description of a multi-line docstring with optional indentation.

methods.name: print_table
methods.description: Prints the textual description of a table to the associated stream.

methods.name: print_docstring
methods.description: Prints the textual description of a docstring to the associated stream.
